messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy started: inference-api v1.24.3 -> v1.25.0 (canary 10%)

alex: heads-up — change window until 18:00 PT. Canary for 20m then gradual ramp if green.

maya: confirmed. Are backout/runbook steps still the same for this service? link?

sre-jen: yes, same as last month. Runbook: https://wiki.redwood.ai/backouts/inference-backout-runbook

sre-jen: TL;DR: rollback threshold = error_rate > 1.5% OR p99 latency +200ms; immediate backout if sustained 2 consecutive collection intervals (5m each).

jonathan: also note we pinned model-serving image tag earlier — if we roll back we need to pin router config to v1.24.3 digest: sha256:8f4a2c

alex: copying critical escape-hatch commands here:
```
# revert service to previous deployment
kubectl -n inference set image deploy/inference-api inference-api=registry.redwood.ai/inference-api:v1.24.3
# pin router traffic
curl -X POST https://router.internal/api/pin -d '{"service":"inference-api","tag":"v1.24.3"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ROUTER_TOKEN'
```

maya: monitoring dashboards -> https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/inference/canary?orgId=1

deploy-bot: Canary metrics update (5m): requests 12.4k, error_rate 0.6%, p50 32ms, p99 210ms

alex: looks fine so far. Keep alerting on error spikes and CPU throttles.

sre-jen: quick note: if backout needed, do NOT run DB migrations in the rollback path. There are none in this release but calling it out.

deploy-bot: Canary metrics update (10m): requests 25.8k, error_rate 1.9% ↑, p99 412ms ↑

jonathan: that's above threshold. Triggering manual review — @sre-jen @alex @olivia please check service logs.

olivia: looking. Logs show increased NCONNS to upstream embedder and timeouts ~200ms. Suspect hot cache eviction after new startup path.

sre-jen: decision: backout. I'll run the pinned revert and remove canary traffic.

alex: ack. Call it out in chat when done so product can rollback feature flags if needed.

sre-jen: running commands now:
```
kubectl -n inference set image deploy/inference-api inference-api=registry.redwood.ai/inference-api:v1.24.3
curl -X POST https://router.internal/api/pin -d '{"service":"inference-api","tag":"v1.24.3"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ROUTER_TOKEN'
```

deploy-bot: Rollback step: started rollback to v1.24.3

deploy-bot: Rollback completed: inference-api pinned to v1.24.3, canary removed. (duration 2m 12s)

alex: thanks. Can we confirm metrics back to baseline?

deploy-bot: Post-rollback metrics (5m): requests 28.1k, error_rate 0.4%, p99 180ms

olivia: opening postmortem doc, adding notes about cache warmup and embedding client timeouts: https://docs.redwood.ai/postmortems/inference-canary-1769981123

maya: will schedule a quick follow-up with infra+ml to reproduce cache eviction locally.

jonathan: noting action item: add a guard in future canaries to warmup caches before traffic shift.

sre-jen: verified runbook steps executed; marking incident resolved for oncall handoff. :white_check_mark:

alex: thanks everyone — will brief PMs and push a hold on next rollout until mitigations in place.
